name: clock_colon_blinked_off
why: Idle clock with the colon blinked off. The clock is deliberately not exposed, so {} is correct; frame_shape folds the blink so this is one screen, not two.

name: salt_cell_diagnostic_idle
why: Diagnostic screen: cell volts, amps, cell temp, instant salt. All zero because the cell was not energised -- instant salt only reads while generating. Unparsed today; backlog 1.8 wants the V/A trend from here.

name: air_sensor_diagnostic
why: Diagnostic menu's raw air sensor, degree glyph as '_'. Deliberately NOT parsed: the idle scroll's 'Air Temp' is the published value, and parsing both would let a menu walk overwrite the scroll with a differently-sampled reading.

name: scroll_air_temp_underscore_degree
why: Idle-scroll air temp, degree glyph as '_'. Parses because the temp patterns anchor on the label and stop at the digits, never reaching the degree marker.

name: beeper_enabled
why: Settings item; no modelled state. {} correct.

name: cell_temp_sensor_degree_symbol
why: Same diagnostic family as air_sensor_diagnostic but with the degree glyph as '°'. The pair proves BOTH encodings occur on this hardware -- the fact behind the setpoint-regex gap this review found.

name: chlorinator_off_percentage_met
why: Status text: chlorinator idle having met its duty percentage. Carries no number, so {} is right -- notably it must not be read as 0%.

name: configuration_menu_locked
why: Menu header. {} correct.

name: default_menu
why: Menu header. {} correct.

name: diagnostic_menu
why: Menu header. {} correct.

name: display_light_partial
why: Mid-render: label drawn, value not yet. {} correct.

name: display_software_menu
why: Menu header. {} correct.

name: scroll_filter_speed_with_slot
why: The steady idle-scroll pump line. Yields speed, active slot, and pump_startup=False (no 'St dly'), which is what tells the cockpit this is a scheduled speed, not a prime.

name: filter_speed1_blanked
why: Slot config with the value blinked/not yet drawn. Must yield {} -- writing 0% here would report the pump as stopped.

name: filter_speed1_percent
why: Slot 1 configured percentage. Merges as {1: 90}, never replacing other slots.

name: filter_timer_t1_speed_link
why: Schedule row binding timer T1 to slot 1 -- NOT a live speed. The near-miss the 'Filter Speed([1-4])' anchor exists to reject; {} is the correct and load-bearing answer.

name: filter_t4_off_partial
why: Timer T4 disabled, tail not yet drawn. {} correct (backlog 1.9 would read these).

name: filter_t4_off
why: Timer T4 disabled. {} correct (backlog 1.9).

name: filter_t1_window_partial
why: Timer T1 window mid-render. {} correct (backlog 1.9).

name: filter_t1_window
why: Timer T1 07:00A-08:00A. {} correct (backlog 1.9).

name: filter_t2_window
why: Timer T2 8:00A-09:30P, single-digit hour form. {} correct (backlog 1.9).

name: filter_t3_window_partial
why: Timer T3 mid-render. {} correct (backlog 1.9).

name: filter_t3_window
why: Timer T3 9:30P-10:30P. {} correct (backlog 1.9).

name: filter_t4_off_head_blanked

name: filter_t1_window_head_blanked

name: filter_t2_window_head_blanked
why: Timer T2 with the start time blanked. {} correct.

name: flow_switch_flow
why: Diagnostic: flow present. Unparsed today; backlog 1.8b.

name: scroll_heater1_manual_off_unprefixed
why: The idle scroll's unprefixed heater line. Routes to pool here only because no valve_mode was passed -- with valve_mode='spa' the same text sets the spa flag. That routing rule is why parse_ac_scroll takes valve_mode at all.

name: instant_salt
why: Point-in-time salt, 0 because the cell was idle. Deliberately not parsed: the scroll's time-averaged 'Salt Level' is the value worth publishing (backlog 1.8b).

name: instant_salt_save_prompt
why: Same screen with the '(+=save)' prompt. {} correct.

name: main_software_revision
why: Main board firmware 4.46. Unparsed; useful in bug reports (backlog 1.8b).

name: serial_noise_long
why: Not LCD content -- a mis-decoded non-display frame reaching text_updated. Pinned here so a future decode fix has a before/after; backlog 1.10.

name: pool_chlorinator_blanked
why: Value blinked off. Must yield {} -- this is the exact shape that would report the chlorinator at 0% if the percent pattern were loosened.

name: pool_chlorinator_percent

name: pool_heater1_blanked
why: Value not drawn. {} correct -- no heater state may be inferred.

name: scroll_salt_level
